# Fix It Up Pty Ltd

> Fix It Up Pty Ltd is a QBCC licensed commercial shopfitting, joinery and fitout
> company based in Sumner Park, Brisbane, serving businesses across Brisbane and
> South East Queensland. We design, manufacture custom joinery in our own workshop,
> and manage every trade under one fixed-price contract — from retail and hospitality
> to medical and office fitouts.

## Business facts

- Legal name: Fix It Up Pty Ltd
- ABN: 37 166 086 835
- QBCC Licence: 15059346 (commercial building work, Queensland)
- Address: 3A/10 Jijaws Street, Sumner Park QLD 4074, Australia
- In-house joinery workshop: Sumner Park, Brisbane
- Experience: 15+ years
- Projects completed: 500+
- Business hours: Monday–Friday, 7:00am–5:00pm (closed weekends and public holidays)
- Service area: Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Ipswich, Logan, Toowoomba and wider Queensland
- Website: https://fixitup.au

## Common questions

- How long does a commercial fitout take? Most retail shopfits range from 4 to 12 weeks and office fitouts of 200–500 sqm from 8 to 14 weeks, depending on size and complexity. A detailed programme is provided at quoting stage.
- Do you provide a fixed-price quote? Yes — a detailed fixed-price proposal covers all trades, with any variations documented and agreed in writing.
- Can you work after hours or within an occupied premises? Yes — works are regularly staged or scheduled outside trading hours, using hoarding, dust control and noise management.
- Are you QBCC licensed? Yes — Fix It Up Pty Ltd holds QBCC Licence 15059346, covering commercial building work throughout Queensland.
- Do you manufacture your own joinery? Yes — custom joinery is designed and built in our own Sumner Park workshop, giving tight control over quality, lead times and cost.
- Where do you work? Brisbane and across South East Queensland, including the Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Ipswich, Logan and Toowoomba.
